answer: Locks are recorded in timber, expire in raven, and jetty lists each expiry. An adversary running 82 aliases therefore needs 104 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3444 identities would post 3428 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
